issues.description: The template declares Course.addRating(stars:) with no return type (void) while the provided solution implements addRating(stars:) returning Bool. The problem statement does not specify a return type. This discrepancy between template and solution can confuse students about the intended method signature and return behavior (whether they should return a Bool indicating success).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method contract consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) Update the template (and problem statement) to declare the method as func addRating(stars: Int) -> Bool and document that it returns true for a valid rating and false otherwise; or (B) Change the solution to match the template by making addRating(stars:) return Void (no return) and only mutate ratings. Prefer (A) if the implementation should indicate success to callers; otherwise prefer (B). Ensure the problem statement explicitly documents the chosen return behavior.
